cmsLinkToDocument_title: Links to documents say what they open
cmsLinkToDocument_description: Lists links to PDF, Office and other document files, asking that the link say what kind of file it opens and that the document be checked on its own.
cmsLinkToDocument_summary_unstated: This link opens a {{format}} document, but nothing says so.
cmsLinkToDocument_hint_unstated: Say the file type next to the link text, such as "Annual report (PDF, 2 MB)", and check that the document is accessible on its own.
cmsLinkToDocument_hint_document: Check that the document is accessible on its own, as the page is.
